anatomy_humans: wrong tooth count or dental arch
artificial skin smoothing, airbrushing, plastic sheen, beauty-filter look
physics_motion: fire without heat shimmer or smoke source
time-lapse cloud motion in real-time shots

modern artifacts: power lines, glass, plastics, zippers, synthetic sheen, signage, vehicles
trademarked franchise designs (tripod anomaly must remain original matte three-legged design)

mirrored nock side (arrow right of riser)

mentor torso entering focus or moving
expression shifting to anger or fear (register = concentration)

cart wheel intact while burning rim
survivor face becoming legible or heroic
any text or glyph anywhere, especially reappearance of removed subtitle
frontal face plane lifting out of near-black exposure fix
sun disc gaining hard edge or streak flare
readable detail on rider or horse (silhouette breach)
